text:
Anya: putting up a short plan for a hybrid quant handoff (hosted -> dedicated -> private). purpose: save cost but keep a safety net for regressions.

Anya: TL;DR: fp8 for attention + int8 (AWQ) for MLP, fallback to fp16 if eval deltas exceed thresholds. canary split: 1% hosted -> 0.5% dedicated. details below.

Priya: drop the eval numbers and the rollback rules? also how do we detect regressions in-flight (alerts + auto-fallback)?

Mike: quick test matrix from last night (small sample):
```
model: rwd/gpt-xxl-v1
variants:
  - fp16 (baseline)
  - hybrid_fp8-attn_awq-int8-mlp
  - gptq_int8_alt
evals: qa-f1, instruct-bleu, ppl-dev
```

Mike: micro results (lower CI):
- fp16 baseline: qa-f1 78.2%, ppl 12.4
- hybrid: qa-f1 77.0% (-1.2), ppl 12.9 (+4%)
- gptq-int8: qa-f1 76.6% (-1.6), ppl 13.3 (+7%)

Zach: those qa-f1 drops matter for convo QA products. what about latency/throughput numbers?

Mike: perf (p95 token latency on hosted infra):
- fp16: 120ms/token
- hybrid: 78ms/token
- gptq-int8: 72ms/token
throughput (seq512) per GPU: fp16 130 tok/s, hybrid 210 tok/s

Eva: cost delta: hybrid ~35% cheaper per token vs fp16, gptq ~40% cheaper but larger quality hit on qa-f1.

Priya: proposed rollout policy:
1) hosted smoke canary: 1% traffic, 24h, collect qa-f1 + ppl per prompt-bucket.
2) pass criteria -> expand to 5% for 48h.
3) after stable 72h, mirror to dedicated reserved pool at 0.5% traffic for on-prem tests.
4) private/on-prem: manual opt-in; auto-fallback allowed per thresholds.

Anya: detection and triggers: eval-metrics stream publishes sliding-window deltas (15m). triggers:
- SEV2 alert if qa-f1 drop >= 1.5 OR ppl increase >= 5% sustained 30m
- Auto-fallback: if SEV2 fires twice in 6h -> switch canary cohort routing back to baseline variant and open incident.

Chris: clarify routing semantics: auto-fallback should only affect canary cohort. we avoid global mass-rollbacks without human ack.

Priya: agreed. policy: auto-fallback only reroutes canary buckets. full rollback across all users requires oncall approval. ephemeral reroute allowed for safety checks.

DeployBot: deploy queued: hybrid-quant-handoff -> hosted-canary (1%) by ci/cd, started at 1749008050, commit 9f3b2a

Mike: smoke test commands we used:
```
python tools/eval_harness.py --model rwd/gpt-xxl-v1 --variant hybrid --suites qa,instruct --samples 200
curl -X POST https://eval-metrics.internal/ingest -d @metrics.json
```

Zach: note: some private clusters have older CUDA/cuDNN kernels; fp8 attention path may fall back to fp16 there. need a kernel-compat checklist.

Anya: added checklist items: kernel compatibility, kv-cache correctness test, deterministic seed smoke (1k samples), and end-to-end synthetic seam test (latency + throughput). also add "safety-lite" eval for hallucination checks.

Eva: docs ask: add a short playbook in eng-ml/playbooks -> "hybrid quant handoff: hosted->dedicated->private" with canary ops and SEV2 runbook.

Priya: request adding 3 prompt buckets for A/B style checks: instruction-heavy, code, casual convo. aggregate per-bucket qa-f1 + ppl.

Chris: infra note: dedicated autoscaler can keep min replicas warm. recommend min_replicas=2 for hybrid variant during canary to keep caches warm.

Anya: approve? if yes I'll kick CI tomorrow and assign oncall for 24h monitoring.

Priya: :thumbsup:

Eva: :thumbsup:
Chris: approve
